build.native: Both Rust SDKs use Bazel -c opt and SDK-scoped cross-crate ThinLTO; both C++ consumers Release -O3.
build.comparator: Pinned upstream release, opt-level=z, full LTO, one codegen unit. Bootstrap/workloads compiled with Hermes -O.
build.clock: Same high-resolution steady_clock __now() hook; full TS suite also uses __now().

benchmarkScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
bootstrap="$PWD/$(rg '\.hbc$' /tmp/hermes-plural-magrinj-bytecode-path)"
run_variant() {
 case "$1" in
  before) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-locale-default-options-hires "$2" ;;
  after) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-rtf-text-buffer-hires "$2" ;;
  magrinj) FORMATJS_BENCH_BOOTSTRAP="$bootstrap" taskset -c 0 /tmp/hi-host-optimized "$2" ;;
 esac
}
run_case() {
 local label="$1" workload="$2"
 for variant in $variants; do
  run_variant "$variant" "$workload" > "/tmp/hermes-rtf-buffer-${label:+$label-}$variant-$round.jsonl"
 done
}
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case '' /tmp/hermes-list-default-overlap.hbc
 run_case tag /tmp/hermes-canonical-control.hbc
 run_case size /tmp/hermes-list-size-control.hbc
 run_case locale /tmp/hermes-canonical-locale-control.hbc
done
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case constructor /tmp/hermes-list-constructor-control.hbc
 run_case relative /tmp/hermes-rtf-bridge-control.hbc
done
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='after before'; else variants='before after'; fi
 run_case full /tmp/hermes-all-api-optimized.hbc
done
profileScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
sdk=/tmp/hermes-extension-sdk-rtf-text-buffer-hires
host=/tmp/hermes-rtf-text-buffer-hires
for smoke in "$sdk"/js/*-smoke.js; do
 case "$smoke" in *datetimeformat-smoke.js) "$host" /tmp/hermes-list-default-datetime-smoke.js ;; *) "$host" "$smoke" ;; esac
done
for variant in before after; do
 if [ "$variant" = before ]; then host=/tmp/hermes-locale-default-options-hires; else host=/tmp/hermes-rtf-text-buffer-hires; fi
 for label in format decimal; do
  if [ "$label" = format ]; then workload=relative-format-profile.js; else workload=relative-decimal-profile.js; fi
  taskset -c 0 "$host" -sample-profiling=chrome -sample-profiling-freq=1000 -profiling-out="/tmp/hermes-rtf-buffer-$label-$variant.cpuprofile" "benchmarks/hermes-intl-extension/$workload" > "/tmp/hermes-rtf-buffer-$label-$variant-profile.log" 2>&1
 done
 "$host" /tmp/hermes-benchmark-clock-check.js > "/tmp/hermes-rtf-buffer-clock-$variant.json"
done
bash /tmp/hermes-rtf-buffer-run.sh
order: Three rounds, CPU0 pinned for every host; before/after/magrinj in rounds1+3, reverse in round2. Full14 native/TS suite on before/after in three rounds, reverse round2. No concurrent builds/profiles during timing. Profiles collected separately first.
change: Reuse already rounded unsigned Latin text for plain standard decimals with at most six integer digits, applying shared grouping thresholds and locale separators. Other cases retain existing traversal. RTF strings take the final number buffer when no prefix was emitted; repeated slots borrow until then.
